resources.string: The next song starts while this one fades out. Off keeps every transition gapless and bit-perfect; during a fade the sound isn\'t bit-perfect.
crossfade, fade, transition, mix, gapless, overlap
Even loudness all the way through.
Stays on each song longer and swaps quickly in the middle.
Straight lines: a slight dip halfway.
Fade from where the music really ends into where the next song starts (silence below −60 dB).
No fade between songs of the same album played in order (live albums, mixes).
A short fade on next, previous or picking a song, instead of a cut.
Shorter songs (interludes, intros) play whole, with gapless transitions.
Crossfade plays two songs at once. On phones with little memory, or when the phone can\'t keep up during fades, songs change as usual instead.
This phone has little memory: songs change without crossfade.
The phone couldn\'t keep up during fades: crossfade is paused until the app restarts.
